## Privacy and data review

- [ ] No secrets, credentials, private vault content, personal data, student data, or confidential documents are included.
- [ ] New network access is explicit, documented, and initiated by the user.
- [ ] The change does not send rosters, grades, student answers, or other protected data to AI providers.
- [ ] The change does not use AI to grade, rank, profile, or evaluate students.
- [ ] Database, backup, synchronization, and migration effects are documented and tested.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] I added or updated focused tests.
- [ ] I updated documentation where behavior changed.
- [ ] I updated every language table for new static UI text.
- [ ] I preserved local-first behavior and existing privacy boundaries.
- [ ] I have read and followed `CONTRIBUTING.md` and `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`.
